dedupe_keys.name: data4cyber a labeled cyber physical dataset for distribution grid management systems under representative ot attacks

description: Data4Cyber: A Labeled Cyber-Physical Dataset for Distribution-Grid Management Systems Under Representative OT Attacks is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ömer Sen, Lennart Bader (Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Information Technology). Data4Cyber is a multi-modal, scenario-based dataset for cyber-physical securityresearch on distribution-grid management systems with distributed energyresources (DER). The release contains seven primary scenarios (S0--S6) coveringa benign baseline, two Industroyer-style Modbus manipulations against PV andBSS, three ARP/MITM false-data-injection variants on meter telemetry, and oneMQTT supply-chain compromise of the price signal. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
